brief: Reduce permissible load in accordance with MG-021 if ambient conditions require it, and evaluate emergency load transfer under ERP-032 if the unit approaches its temperature limit. Ensure any transferred load is assessed against the receiving asset's available capacity at prevailing ambient temperatures, accounting for de-rating under MG-021. Because the asset utilizes ONAN cooling, the specific provisions regarding forced cooling in MG-021 and MG-025 do not apply.
